blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
We present InterView-C, a German multimodal corpus of 27 survey interviews conducted entirely in virtual reality, with both interlocutors represented by avatars.
The corpus aligns spoken interaction with synchronized behavioral data, including gaze, head and body movement, facial behavior, hand and finger tracking.
Its reference transcripts and linguistic annotations provide a reliable interface between this multimodal spoken interaction and predominantly text-based NLP methods.
This interface is important because automatically transcribing speech can distort linguistically relevant information, while downstream models trained on existing resources may additionally face transfer challenges when applied to transcribed spoken data.
InterView-C therefore provides word-timed and manually post-edited verbatim transcripts for all 54 recordings, interview-item timings, questionnaire responses and negation cue and scope annotations for 1,422 sentences, 1,398 of them doubly annotated ( α = 0.87 \alpha=0.87 for cues; α = 0.81 \alpha=0.81 for scopes).
We demonstrate both challenges empirically: nine open-weight ASR systems disproportionately misrecognize short closed answers and number words, while negation models trained on existing corpora show lower and highly variable performance on our transcribed interviews than a model trained on the InterView-C annotations.
InterView-C thus enables linguistic analyses of spoken interaction while retaining their alignment with rich multimodal behavior.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍InterView-C,这是一套德国的多模式调查,由27个完全在虚拟现实中进行的访谈组成,两个对话者都以异形为代表。
被体将口语互动与同步的行为数据相协调,包括凝视,头部和身体运动,面部行为,手和指的跟踪.
它的参考记录和语言说明为这种多式口语互动和主要基于文本的NLP方法提供了可靠的接口.
这个接口很重要,因为自动转录语音可以扭曲语言相关信息,而接受过现有资源培训的下游模型在被应用到转录口语数据时可能会面临更多的传输挑战.
因此,InterView-C为所有54个录音、访谈项目时间安排、问卷答复以及否定提示和范围说明提供了文字定时和人工编辑后逐字记录稿,其中1 398个是附加说明的(α=0.87\alpha=0.87;α=0.81\alpha=0.81)。

因此,InterView-C可以对口语互动进行语言分析,同时保持其与丰富多式行为的一致性。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Face-to-face interaction between two or more interlocutors is a complex system that extends well beyond the vocal channel.
Facial expressions, gaze and hand and arm gestures are among the many signals that accompany speech in face-to-face conversation ( Vigliocco et al., 2014 ; Holler and Levinson, 2019 ) .
These signals can be analyzed separately, but each offers insight into only a thin slice of the interaction.
A holistic understanding of a conversation therefore requires capturing these interlinked modalities simultaneously.
This requires (a) recording the signals in a machine-readable, synchronized format and (b) methods to process and analyze these data.
As declining response rates and rising fieldwork costs pose challenges to survey research ( Williams and Brick, 2018 ; Luiten et al., 2020 ) , new interview modes are being developed, ranging from computer-assisted web and live video interviews (CAWI, CALVI) to AI-assisted interviewing systems.
Besides reducing costs, these modes facilitate the recording of additional modalities, such as participants’ audio and video (subject to consent and GDPR compliance), providing further insights into their behavior.
Access to these additional modalities allows further insights into participants’ behaviors to be inferred, which is particularly valuable in the field of survey research.
blocks.zh:
两个或两个以上对话者之间的面对面互动是一个复杂的系统,远远超出声道.
脸部表情,目光和手和手臂手势都是在面对面谈话中伴随演讲的众多信号之一(Vigliocco等,2014;Holler和Levinson,2019.
这些信号可以单独分析,但每个信号都只提供一小部分相互作用的洞察力.
因此,全面理解对话需要同时抓住这些相互关联的模式。
这就需要(a) 以机器可读、同步的格式记录信号;(b) 处理和分析这些数据的方法。
由于回复率下降和实地工作成本上升对调查研究构成挑战(Williams and Brick, 2018;Luiten等, 2020),新的访谈模式正在开发中,从计算机辅助网络和现场视频访谈(CAWI, CALVI)到AI辅助访谈系统.
除了降低成本外,这些模式还有助于记录其他模式,如参与者的音频和视频(须征得同意和遵守GDPR),从而进一步深入了解他们的行为。
利用这些额外方式可以进一步了解参与者的行为,这对调查研究领域特别有价值。

blocks.en: These among others motivated the development of InterView ( Schrottenbacher et al., 2026 ) , a VR interview system built on Va.Si.Li-Lab ( Mehler et al., 2023 ) that has a particular focus on capturing and contextualizing these multimodal signals.

blocks.en:
With InterView, we conducted 27 survey interviews in which interviewer and interviewee meet as avatars in a shared virtual room, while the headsets of both record their gaze, facial expressions and head, body, hand and finger movements alongside their speech.
Recording these signals addresses requirement (a), but not (b): only a few current models process nonverbal channels, and even models described as multimodal typically accept text, images and audio ( Yin et al., 2024 ; Microsoft et al., 2025 ) , but not gaze, facial expressions or body motion.
Spoken interaction is therefore still analyzed by passing ASR output to text-based NLP methods, which can fail at two points: ASR can distort linguistically relevant information ( Maheshwari et al., 2025 ; Koenecke et al., 2024 ) and models trained on existing text resources may not transfer reliably to transcribed speech, as observed for negation detection ( Hammerla et al., 2025b ) .
Human-verified transcripts and linguistic annotations that share the time base of the tracking data provide a reliable interface between the two and keep text-based analyses aligned with the nonverbal behavior.
Our contribution is the InterView-C corpus, which consists of three parts (Figure 1 ): 1. VR interaction data (Section 4 ): for all 27 interviews, synchronized tracking of both speakers (eyes, head, body, face, hands and fingers), word-timed automatic transcripts, time windows of the questionnaire items and the questionnaire responses. 2. Reference transcripts (Section 5.1 ): a manually post-edited verbatim transcript of all 54 recordings (57,347 tokens), which we use to evaluate nine open-weight ASR systems and to analyze their errors on survey interview speech. 3. Negation annotations (Section 5.2 ): negation cue and scope labels for 1,422 transcribed sentences, with a comparison between training on InterView-C and cross-corpus transfer from existing negation resources.
blocks.zh:
我们与InterView进行了27次调查访谈,访谈者与受访谈者在一个共享的虚拟房间里作为异形相会,而这两个人的头像记录了他们的目光、面部表情和头部、身体、手和指部的动向以及他们的演讲。
记录这些信号符合要求(a),但不符合(b):只有少数目前的模型处理非语言通道,甚至被描述为多模式的模型通常接受文本,图像和音频(Yin等,2024;Microsoft等,2025),但不凝视,面部表情或身体运动.
因此,通过将ASR输出传递到基于文本的NLP方法,语句互动仍然被分析出,这可以在两个点上失败: ASR可以扭曲语言相关信息(Maheshwari等人,2025年;Koenecke等人,2024年),而对现有文本资源进行培训的模型可能无法可靠地被转录到转录语音中,如被观测到的否定检测(Hammerla等人,2025b.).
人类验证的文字记录和语言说明共享跟踪数据的时间基础,为两者提供了可靠的接口,并保持文本分析与非语言行为一致.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Technology-mediated interviews range from live video between human interlocutors to virtual and LLM-based interviewers, with prior work examining disclosure, data quality and respondent experience across these settings ( Endres et al., 2023 ; Conrad et al., 2023 ; Lind et al., 2013 ; Lucas et al., 2014 ; Barari et al., 2026 ; Lang and Eskenazi, 2025 ; Leybzon et al., 2025 ; Krajcovic et al., 2026 ) .
These studies show that both interview modality and the perceived nature of the interviewer can affect disclosure and response behavior.
More recent systems increasingly support conversational and adaptive interviewing, including LLM-based chatbots, voice agents and embodied virtual interviewers.
Interviews between avatars have also been studied in desktop virtual worlds and qualitative VR settings ( Hasler et al., 2013 ; Young et al., 2024 ) , but, to our knowledge, no survey corpus combines two human interlocutors represented as avatars with headset tracking of both parties.
blocks.zh:
以技术为媒介的访谈从人类对话者之间的实况录像到虚拟和基于LLM的访谈者,其前期工作审查披露、数据质量和答复者的经验(Endres等,2023;Conrad等,2023;Lind等,2013;Lucas等,2014;Barari等,2026;Lang和Eskenazi,2025;Leybzon等,2025;Krajkovic等,2026)。
这些研究表明,采访方式和被采访者的感知性质都可能影响披露和反应行为.
较近期的系统越来越多地支持对话性和适应性访谈,包括基于LLM的聊天机器人,语音代理和所体现虚拟访谈者.
在桌面虚拟世界和定性VR环境中也研究了Avatar人之间的访谈(Hasler等,2013;Young等,2024),但据我们所知,没有调查机构将两个作为Avatar人的人类对话者与双方耳机跟踪结合起来。

blocks.en:
Multimodal corpora of face-to-face interaction range from meetings ( McCowan et al., 2005 ) and acted and improvised emotional dialogue ( Busso et al., 2008 ) to German route descriptions annotated for speech-gesture alignment ( Lücking et al., 2013 ) .
Motion-capture corpora record body and finger motion together with each speaker’s audio in dyadic conversations ( Lee et al., 2019 ) and recent corpora have expanded to include hundreds or thousands of hours ( Agrawal et al., 2025 ; McLean et al., 2025 ) .
These corpora are recorded in physical rooms using cameras or marker-based capture.
Data recorded with VR headsets, which capture gaze and facial expressions in the context of avatar animation, are still rare ( Rack et al., 2023 ) .
For instance, Kim and Lee (2025) use the data to predict social connection based on turn-taking, gaze and nodding in dyadic VR conversations.
Furthermore, none of these corpora contain structured survey interviews or pair the interaction with the interviewee’s survey answers.
Releasing such data requires care, since head and hand motion alone suffices to re-identify VR users ( Nair et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh:
面对面互动的多模式公司从会议(McCowan等,2005年)以及行动和即兴的情感对话(Busso等,2008年)到附加说明的德国路线描述(Lücking等,2013年)。
动作-抓取"蝎子"(Motion-capture corpora)的机身和手指运动,以及每个演讲者在dyadic对话中的音频(Lee等,2019年),而最近的"蝎子"(corpora)已经扩张到包括了上百或上千小时(Agrawal等,2025年;McLean等,2025年).
这些蝎子被记录在物理室内,使用相机或以标记为基础的捕获.
以VR头像记录的数据,在外形动画中能捕捉到目光和面部表情,至今仍然很少(Rack等,2023.).
例如,Kim和Lee(2025年)利用这些数据,根据Dyadic VR对话中的转弯、凝视和点头预测社会联系。
此外,这些公司中没有一个包含有条理的调查访谈,也没有将互动与受访者的调查答复联系起来。
公布这些数据需要注意,因为单靠头和手动就足以重新识别VR用户(Nair等人,2023年)。

blocks.en:
ASR systems that perform well on read-speech benchmarks have been shown to degrade substantially on conversational speech, with errors correlating with disfluencies ( Maheshwari et al., 2025 ) , with Whisper-based systems hallucinating content, particularly over non-speech audio ( Koenecke et al., 2024 ) .
Although ASR is already used to transcribe and monitor survey interviews ( Sun and Yan, 2023 ; Wollin-Giering et al., 2024 ) , its accuracy has been assessed on long, open-ended speech, not on the short closed answers of interviewer–interviewee dialogue on which standardized survey data rest.
blocks.zh:
在读音基准上表现良好的ASR系统被证明在对话口语中大幅退化,其出错与出错相关(Maheshwari等,2025年),与Whiper系统有幻觉内容,特别是在非发音上(Koenecke等,2024年).
虽然ASR已经被用来转录和监督调查访谈(Sun and Yan, 2023;Wollin-Giering等, 2024),但其准确性已经通过长而开放的演讲来评估,而不是通过访谈者-访谈者对话的简短的闭门回答来评估,而标准化的调查数据则停留在对话上.

blocks.en:
Negation has received comparatively limited attention in computational linguistics and remains underrepresented in widely used NLU resources ( Jiménez-Zafra et al., 2020 ; Hossain et al., 2022 ) .
Existing work has primarily focused on cue and scope detection in written text, with dedicated datasets concentrated on English and comparatively few resources available for other languages, including German ( Jiménez-Zafra et al., 2020 ; Hartmann et al., 2021 ) .
This gap is particularly pronounced for spoken and conversational language, for which annotated negation corpora are scarce.
More recent work has considered negation in spoken and multimodal interaction, including VR settings ( AbuSaleh et al., 2026 ; Hammerla et al., 2026 ) .
Moreover, previous cross-corpus evaluations have found substantial variation in negation-detection performance across datasets ( Hammerla et al., 2025b ) , further motivating the development of annotated resources for German spoken and interactional language.
blocks.zh:
忽略在计算语言学中受到的关注相对有限,在被广泛使用的NLU资源中仍然代表性不足(Jiménez-Zafra等,2020;Hossain等,2022).
现有工作主要侧重于书面文本中的提示和范围探测,专用数据集集中在英语上,可供其他语言使用的资源相对较少,包括德语(Jiménez-Zafra等,2020;Hartmann等,2021年)。
这种差距在口头和谈话语言中尤其明显,对此,附加注释的否定公司很少。
最近的工作考虑了在口头和多模式互动中的否定,包括VR环境(AbuSaleh等,2026;Hammerla等,2026)。
此外,以往的跨公司评价发现,不同数据集的否定-检测性能有很大差异(Hammerla等,2025年b),这进一步推动了开发德语和互动语言附加说明的资源。

blocks.en: 3 Experiment Setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en:
Each interviewee was first briefed by an instructor.
The participant then chose one of four avatars (A-D) to represent them in VR (Appendix 3 ).
One of the remaining three avatars was then assigned to the interviewer.
The interviewee then put on the Meta Quest Pro VR headset, after which the instructor left the room and the interview began.
The interviewer and interviewee were in different locations and only met in VR.
The interviewees had not seen their interviewer in person beforehand.
The three interviewers were members of the project team and had no prior experience conducting interviews.
blocks.zh:
每位受访者首先由一名教官介绍情况。
然后,与会者选择了四个阿凡达(A-D)中的一个在VR(附录3 )中代表他们.
其余3名阿凡达被分配到采访者手中.
受访者再将"Meta Quest Pro VR"头盔上架,之后教官离开房间并开始了采访.
受访者和受访者在不同地点相会,只在VR相会.
受访者没有事先亲自见到其访谈者。
三名面谈者是项目小组成员,以前没有面试经验。

blocks.en:
The interview was conducted in a virtual room that contained three large windows as well as some cupboards, plants and a couch (Figure 2 ).
At the center of the room stood a large office desk, with the interviewee seated at one end and the interviewer at the other.
A browser panel on the desk, facing the interviewer, displayed the LimeSurvey questionnaire, which the interviewer operated during the interview.
The side facing the interviewee showed a mirror in which they could see their own avatar, imitating the self-view of a video interview and strengthening the sense of embodiment ( González-Franco et al., 2010 ) .
For items with response scales, the answer options were also displayed to the interviewee on the same panel.
blocks.zh:
访谈在一个虚拟房间进行,该房间有3个大窗户以及一些柜子、植物和沙发(图2)。
房间中央站出一个大的办公桌,受访者坐在一端,受访者坐在一端.
桌上一个面对采访者的浏览器面板展示了采访者在采访期间操作的LimeSurvey问卷.
面对被采访者的一面展示了一面镜子,他们可以在镜子里看到自己的相貌,模仿了视频采访的自视,并强化了浮雕感(González-Franco等,2010年).
对于具有响应尺度的项目,也在同一面板上向受访者展示了答案选项.

blocks.en:
During the interview, all data the Meta Quest Pro can capture were recorded, for both the interviewer and interviewee.
This includes gaze, face, body, hand and finger tracking alongside the audio.
The main questionnaire is listed in Appendix D ; all 131 items are part of the release.
blocks.zh:
在采访中,Meta Quest Pro可以捕捉到的所有数据都被记录下来,既包括采访者,也包括被采访者.
这包括目光、相貌、身体、手和手指跟随音频。
主要问题单载于附录D;所有131件物品都是发行品的一部分。

blocks.en:
The interview was conducted in German.
The interviewer read out a standardized questionnaire of 52 items: 37 asked in every interview, 11 only when a previous answer made them applicable and four income follow-ups that were never triggered.
Most of the items were taken from the German National Education Panel Study (NEPS) ( Blossfeld and von Maurice, 2019 ) , listed in Appendix D .
The questionnaire covers life satisfaction, partnership and family, education and employment, earned income, locus of control and social belonging and trust.
Since we wanted to learn how the avatar setting affects answers that may cause discomfort in conventional interviews, the questionnaire deliberately includes items known to be sensitive, such as income and relationship conflicts ( Tourangeau and Yan, 2007 ; Yan, 2021 ) and scales on socially aversive traits such as narcissism and Machiavellianism ( Paulhus and Williams, 2002 ) .
The interview was designed to take about 20 minutes in total to complete.
After the interview, the interviewee completed an experience questionnaire on the VR setting, the avatars and honesty (35 items for every respondent plus up to 7 open follow-ups) and the interviewer completed a protocol of the interview (11 items plus up to 14 follow-ups on technical problems and the respondent’s discomfort).
blocks.zh:
采访以德文进行.
访谈者宣读了一份52项的标准化问卷:每次访谈中有37项询问,11项仅在先前的答复使其适用时询问,4项收入跟踪从未启动。
大部分物品取自附录D列出的"德国国家教育小组研究"(德語:Nepsfeld and von Maurice, 2019).
调查表涵盖生活满意度、伙伴关系和家庭、教育和就业、挣取的收入、控制地点以及社会归属和信任。
由于我们想知道Avatar的设定如何影响那些在常规访谈中可能造成不适的答案,问卷中刻意包括了已知的敏感内容,如收入和关系冲突(Tourangeau and Yan, 2007;Yan, 2021)以及自恋和Machiavellianism等社会逆向特征的尺度(Paulhus and Williams, 2002)。
采访的设计总共需要约20分钟才能完成.
采访结束后,受访者完成了关于VR设置,相貌和诚实的经验问卷(每个受访者35个项目加上最多7个公开后续),受访者完成了采访协议(11个项目加上最多14个技术问题后续和受访者的不适).

blocks.en: 4 Corpus
blocks.zh: 4个公司

blocks.en:
InterView-C contains 27 German-language survey interviews, each conducted entirely in VR, with both the human interviewer and human interviewee represented by avatars.
For every interview, the corpus comprises three parts (Figure 1 , Appendix Table 10 ):
(1) the VR interaction data , i.e., synchronized tracking streams of both interlocutors (gaze, head, body, face, hands and fingers), word-timed automatic transcripts of both speakers, time windows for each questionnaire item and the questionnaire data;
(2) the reference transcripts , a manual verbatim post-edit of the automatic transcripts (Section 5.1 ); and
(3) the negation annotations , cue and scope labels on a sample of the transcribed sentences (Section 5.2 ).
All layers are timestamped, enabling, for example, the interviewee’s gaze and facial expressions during a spoken response to be retrieved in a single query.
This section gives the overall composition and statistics and describes the VR interaction data; the two human-annotated parts are described in Section 5 .
The raw audio is not part of the corpus (Section 4.4 ).
blocks.zh:
InterView-C包含27个德语调查访谈,每个访谈都完全用VR进行,其中人类访谈者与受访谈者均由相声代表.
每次面谈都由三个部分组成(图1,附录表10):
(1) VR 互动数据,即同步跟踪两个对话者(gaze、头、体、面、手和指)的流程、两个发言者的文字自动记录、每个调查问卷项目的时间窗口和调查问卷数据;
(2) 参考资料誊本,自动誊本编辑后手工逐字记录(第5.1节);
(3) 转写句子样本上的否定说明、提示和范围标签(第5.2节)。
所有层层都印有时间戳,例如,使受访者在口头答复时的目光和面部表情能在单一查询中检索。
本节介绍总体构成和统计数据,并介绍VR互动数据;第5节介绍了两个人为说明的部分。
原始音频不是犯罪事实的一部分(第4.4节)。

blocks.en: 4.1 Composition and Scope
blocks.zh: 4.1 组成和范围

blocks.en:
Each interview is composed of two speakers: one of the 27 interviewees and one of the three interviewers, who conducted 19, 6 and 2 interviews, respectively.
According to the interviewer protocol, 19 interviewees were male and 8 female.
The participants received no compensation and were all highly educated with ages ranging from 18 to 60.
The interviewees chose avatars A, B and C 13, 11 and 3 times, respectively, while avatar D was never chosen.
The avatar representing the interviewer was chosen from among the remaining three avatars, once the interviewee had selected their own avatar.
This process was not randomized, resulting in six interviews with avatar A, five interviews with avatar B, eight interviews with avatar C and eight interviews with avatar D.
blocks.zh:
每次访谈由两位发言人组成:一位是27位受访者,一位是3位受访者,他们分别进行了19,6和2次访谈.
根据面谈程序,19名面谈者是男性,8名是女性。
参与者没有得到任何补偿,他们都受过18至60岁的高等教育。
受访者分别选择了A型,B型和C型13相,11相和3相,而A型D则从未被选中.
代表受访者的阿凡达从剩下的三个阿凡达中挑选出,一旦受访者选择了自己的阿凡达.
这个过程没有被随意地分出来,结果六次采访了阿凡达A,五次采访了阿凡达B,八次采访了阿凡达C和八次采访了阿凡达D.

blocks.en: 4.2 Corpus Statistics
blocks.zh: 4.2 公司统计

blocks.en:
Interviews last a median of 21.7 minutes.
The questionnaire itself takes a median of 13.1 minutes when measured from the first to the last administered item.
The remaining time is spent on setup, introduction, instructions and closing statements.
Since interviewers read every item and its answer options, they produce most of the speech.
In the automatic transcript, they produce a median of 1,315 words per interview (range 1,182–2,083), against 420 (115-1,564) for the interviewees.
The high variance on the interviewee side reflects the mix of closed items, which typically receive one- to three-word answers and open-ended items, which elicit substantially longer responses depending on the participant.
Of the 3,537 questionnaire answers, 2,440 correspond to items that were actually asked, of which 2,346 received a substantive answer, 64 no answer and 30 with the label “don’t know” ; the remaining 1,097 are items that were not asked (filter skips, break-offs or missing questionnaires).
Table 1 gives an overview.
blocks.zh:
面谈持续中位数21.7分钟。
调查表本身从第一个到最后一个经管理的项目测得的中位数为13.1分钟。
剩下的时间用于设置、介绍、指示和结束语。
由于受访者阅读了每个项目及其答案选项,因此产生大部分演讲内容.
在自动笔录中,他们每次面谈的中位数为1 315个字(1 182至2 083个不等),而受访者为420个(115至1 564个)。
受访方差异很大,反映了封闭项目的混合,通常得到一至三字的答案和开放式项目,这需要根据参与者的不同而得到更长的答复。
在3,537份调查问卷答复中,2,440份答复与实际询问的项目相对应,其中2,346份得到实质性答复,64份没有答复,30份有 " 不知道 " 标签;其余的1,097份是未询问的项目(过滤器跳过、断出或缺失的调查问卷)。
表1概述了情况。

blocks.en: Table 1: General statistics about the data InterView-C contains.
blocks.zh: 表1:关于InterView-C数据的一般统计数据。

blocks.en: 4.3 Synchronization and Tracking Data
blocks.zh: 4.3 同步和跟踪数据

blocks.en:
All streams of both headsets are placed on one session clock: each headset’s clock is mapped onto a shared clock with a per-session offset and sub-second timing follows the audio sample clock (Appendix A ).
Tracking is logged at a median of 18.4Hz, which suffices for gaze, head, hand and facial behavior at the level of words and turns but not for saccades or brief facial events.
The hands were tracked in 38.2%(left) and 40.3%(right) of the frames; untracked frames are flagged.
blocks.zh:
两个耳机的所有流都放在一个会话钟上:每个耳机的时钟被映射到一个共享的时钟上,每个会话的偏移,分秒计时按照音频样本时钟(Appendix A.
追踪记录在18.4Hz的中位数上,这足以在文字和转动一级进行目光、头部、手和面部行为,但不能用于圣人或短暂的面部事件。
手被跟踪到框的38.2%(左)和40.3%(右);未跟踪的框被标记出.

blocks.en: 4.4 De-identification and Release
blocks.zh: 4.4 消除识别和释放

blocks.en:
All tracking streams, both transcript layers, the item windows, the questionnaire data and both task resources are available on request at huggingface 1 1 1 https://hf.co/datasets/AnonymousKiwi/InterView-C under a data use agreement that restricts use to non-commercial research and prohibits re-identification; the raw audio is withheld.
The code is released under AGPLv3 on GitHub 2 2 2 https://github.com/TheBv/faces-dataset-pre-study .
Transcripts are verbatim with word-level timestamps; names of persons, places and institutions are replaced by typed placeholders.
Head and hand motion alone can re-identify VR users ( Nair et al., 2023 ; Miller et al., 2020 ) and the release adds gaze, facial blendshapes and answers on gender, partnership, education, occupation and income.
Re-identification from motion, however, requires reference recordings of the same person and the corpus contains no names, voices or images; with restricted access, this lowers but does not eliminate the risk.
Participants gave informed consent to the recording and to the release of the de-identified data for research purposes.
blocks.zh:
所有追踪流、记录层、项目窗口、问卷数据以及两个任务资源均可应要求查阅。 根据限制非商业研究使用并禁止重新识别的数据使用协议;不保留原始音频。
在GitHub 2 2 2 https://github.com/TheBv/faces-dataset-pre-study上,该代码在AGPLv3下发布.
缩写为带有字级时间戳的逐字记录;人员,地点和机构名称由打字的占位符取而代之.
单是头部和手动就可以重新识别VR用户(Nair等人,2023;Miller等人,2020年),发布内容增加了对性别,伙伴关系,教育,职业和收入的凝视,面部混合形状和答案.
然而,从动议中重新确定身份需要同一个人的参考录音,而且诉讼书中没有任何姓名、声音或图像;由于访问受到限制,这就降低了这种风险,但并没有消除风险。
与会者在知情的情况下同意为研究目的记录和公布已查明的数据。

blocks.en: 5 Human Annotation and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5 人类注释和评价

blocks.en:
The two human-annotated parts of InterView-C target the speech and text channel, through which most current models access spoken interaction.
For each part, we describe its creation and evaluate current models on it: the reference transcripts serve as an ASR benchmark (Section 5.1 ) and the negation annotations as training and test data for negation cue and scope detection (Section 5.2 ).
blocks.zh:
InterView-C的两个人注解部分以语音和文本通道为目标,目前大多数模型通过该通道访问口语互动.
对于每一部分,我们都要描述其创建情况并评价其目前的模型:参考记录作为ASR基准(第5.1节),否定说明作为否定提示和范围探测的培训和测试数据(第5.2节)。

blocks.en: 5.1 Reference Transcripts and ASR Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5.1 参考记录和ASR评价

blocks.en:
Survey interviews are a demanding setting for ASR:
Interviewers largely read out scripted items and answer options, resembling the read speech that dominates ASR training data, but embedded in a dialogue: each headset recording contains long silences while the other person speaks, interspersed with short backchannels ( mhm , ja ) and filled pauses.
Interviewees, in contrast, speak spontaneously, often answering with a single word, and their answers contain disfluencies such as filled pauses, repetitions and self-repairs, possibly reflecting uncertainty in the unfamiliar setting.
We therefore manually corrected the transcripts of all 54 recordings (one per speaker and interviewer) and use them to benchmark current open-weight ASR models.
blocks.zh:
调查访谈是ASR要求很高的环境:
受访者主要朗读脚本项目和答题选项,与主导ASR训练数据的已读语音相类似,但嵌入了对话中:每张耳机录音包含长的沉默而对方说话,用短后道(mhm, ja)相接并填充暂停.
相形之下,受访者自发地说话,常常用一个单词回答,他们的答案含有填充的暂停,重复和自修等缺点,可能反映了陌生环境中的不确定性.
因此,我们手动更正了所有54个录音记录(每个发言者和采访者各一份)的录音记录,并用这些记录来衡量目前开放量的ASR模型。

blocks.en:
We first transcribed silence-delimited segments with CrisperWhisper ( Zusag et al., 2024 ) , a Whisper model fine-tuned for verbatim transcription, using beam search.
It was chosen for its strong German results and word-level timestamps.
Five annotators post-edited them in a web interface with audio playback, one annotator per recording.
The transcripts are verbatim: filled pauses ( äh , ähm , mhm ), repetitions and false starts are kept and unintelligible words are marked as [unknown] .
Numbers up to thirteen and colloquial elisions are written out.
The final reference contains 57,347 tokens, including 1,432 filled pauses (2.5%) and 380 immediate word repetitions.
About four in five filled pauses were added by annotators, and post-editing changed around 9.1% of the words of the automatic transcripts.
Forced alignment with a German wav2vec 2.0 model ( Baevski et al., 2020 ; Wang et al., 2021 ) assigns timestamps to 99.7% of the reference words.
Mapped onto the session clock, these words form the ReferenceWord layer of the corpus.
blocks.zh:
我们先用CrisperWhisper(Zusag等, 2024年)转录了沉默限制片段,
它被选用于其强大的德文成果和词级时间戳.
5名注释员在编辑后将其用回放音频的网络界面,每次录制1名注释员.
记录片为逐字记录:填充的暂停(äh, ähm, mhm),重复和虚假的起步保留并标出不可知的字.
数字可达13个,口语化的语气被写出.
最终参考书中包含57,347个令牌,包括1,432个已填充的暂停(2.5%)和380个即时的单词重复.
大约五分之四被填充的暂停被注解者所添加,后编辑时变化了约9.1%的自动笔录词.
强制与德文wav2vec 2.0模型对接(Baevski等,2020;Wang等,2021)为参考词分配了99.7%的时间戳.
这些字组成了本体的参考Word层。

blocks.en:
We evaluate nine systems zero-shot under three decoding regimes (Table 2 ).
Three systems decode the full recordings with their own long-form strategy: Whisper large-v3 and large-v3-turbo ( Radford et al., 2023 ) and CrisperWhisper 2 ( Wagner et al., 2026 ) in verbatim mode.
WhisperX ( Bain et al., 2023 ) uses its built-in Voice Activity Detection (VAD) and runs Whisper large-v3 on the resulting segments.
The other five receive voice-activity segments of at most 30 s from Silero VAD ( Silero Team, 2024 ) : Qwen3-ASR-1.7B ( Shi et al., 2026 ) , Voxtral Mini 3B ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , Parakeet-TDT-0.6B-v3 and Canary-1B-v2 ( Sekoyan et al., 2025 ) and Phi-4-multimodal ( Microsoft et al., 2025 ) .
To vary the decoding strategy, we also ran CrisperWhisper 2 on the VAD segments in verbatim and intended (clean) modes.
We further ran Whisper large-v3-turbo on the full recordings without conditioning on previously decoded text.
Where a model exposes a language option, it is set to German.
Before scoring, we normalize both texts: we lower-case them, remove punctuation, spell out numbers, expand abbreviations and elisions, map filled-pause tags to filled pauses, drop other non-speech tags ( [laughter] ) and treat open, hyphenated and closed compounds alike ( Zoom Call , Zoom-Call , Zoomcall ).
Our main measure, word error rate (WER), also removes filled pauses and cut-off word fragments ( hau- ) from both sides, since only verbatim systems produce them.
The verbatim WER keeps the filled pauses.
We report WER pooled over all recordings, with 95% confidence intervals from a bootstrap over interviews (1,000 resamples).
Because WER treats all words alike and agrees poorly with human judgments of transcript quality, we also report character error rate (CER) and semantic distance (SemDist; Kim et al., 2021 ), which agrees best with human judgments in comparative studies ( Kim et al., 2022 ) .
SemDist is one minus the cosine similarity between multilingual E5 embeddings ( Wang et al., 2024 ) of each reference line and the hypothesis words aligned to it, averaged over lines.
blocks.zh:
我们在三个解码制度下评估了9个系统零发(表2)。
三个系统用自己的长式战略来解码全部录音: Whisper big-v3 and big-v3-turbo (Radford等, 2023年)和CrisperWhisper 2 (Wagner等, 2026年)以逐字记录方式进行.
WhisperX(Bain等,2023年)使用其内置语音活性检测(VAD),并运行Whisper大V3在生成的片段上.
其他5人从Silero VAD(Silero Team,2024年)获得最多30 s的语音活动段: Qune3-ASR-1.7B(Shi等,2026年),Voxtral Mini 3B(Liu等,2025年),Parakeet-TD-0.6B-v3和Canary-1B-v2(Sekoyan等,2025年)和Phi-4-多式 (微软等,2025).
为了改变解码策略,我们还用逐字记录和预定(干净)模式在VAD部分运行了CrisperWhisper 2。
我们进一步运行了Whisper大V3涡轮 在全程录音上 不附加条件 之前的解码文本。
当一个模型暴露语言选项时,它会被设定为德语.
在打分前,我们把两种文本都正常化:我们缩小大小,去掉平分,拼出数字,扩展缩写和表示,地图上填充的暂停标记来填充暂停,放下其他非发音标记([笑声]),并同样对待开放的,有连字符的和封闭的化合物(Zoom Call,ZoomCall.
我们的主要衡量标准,字错误率(WER),也从两边去除已填充的暂停和断出字片段(hau-),因为只有逐字记录系统才能产生.
逐字记录WER保留了填充的暂停.
我们报告WER集合了所有录音, 95%的置信间隔 来自靴子 与采访(1,000再印)。
由于WER对待所有字词都相同,对人对笔录质量的判断也不太认同,因此我们也报告性格错误率(CER)和语义距离(SemDist;Kim等,2021年),比较研究中对人类判断最认同(Kim等,2022年).
SemDist是每条参考线多语种E5嵌入(Wang et al., 2024)与与之对齐的假说单词之间的同位素相近的一减一,平均于行.

blocks.en:
Excluding the automatic transcript the reference was derived from, WhisperX achieves the lowest WER (8.0%), followed by Qwen3-ASR (10.4%).
Qwen3-ASR is in turn better than Canary (1.1 points, CI 0.8–1.4) and slightly better than Voxtral (0.4, CI 0.0–0.8), whereas Voxtral, Parakeet, Phi-4 and Canary cannot be separated: all differences between adjacent systems in this group have CIs that include zero.
blocks.zh:
不包括该参考文献的自动记录,WhisperX达到了最低的WER(8.0%),其次是Qune3-ASR(10.4%)。
Qune3-ASR转而优于加那利(1.1分,CI 0.8–1.4分)并略优于活克特拉尔(0.4分,CI 0.0–0.8分),而活克特拉尔(Voxtral),帕拉克特(Parakeet),Phi-4和加那利(Canary)则无法分离:这个组中相邻系统之间的所有差异都有包含零的CI.

blocks.en: Table 2: ASR results on all 54 recordings (%, SemDist × 100 \times 100 ; lower is better except for recall). WER : WER without filled pauses; CER : character error rate; SemD : mean semantic distance per reference line; IR / IE : WER on interviewer/interviewee recordings; Verb. : WER with filled pauses kept; Del. / Ins. : deletions/insertions relative to the reference length; Cue / Num : recall of negation cues and number words (Section 5.1 , Results); Hall./h : inserted passages of at least five words per hour of audio. † The reference was post-edited from this transcript and is shown for reference only. ‡ Without conditioning on previously decoded text.
blocks.zh: 表2:所有54个录音(%,SemDist × 100\times 100;除召回之外,更低)的ASR结果。 WER : WER 没有被填充的暂停; CER : 字符出错率; SemD : 每个参考行的平均语义距离; IR / IE : 访问者/访问者录音上的WER; Verb. : WER 中包含已填充的暂停保存; Del. / Ins. : 相对于引用长度的删除/插入; Cue / Num:召回否定的提示和数字词(第5.1节,结果);Hall./h:插入了每小时至少五个字的音频段落。 参考文献是本记录后编辑的,仅供参考。 ‡ 不对先前已解码的文本附加条件 。

blocks.en:
CER and SemDist largely reproduce this ranking but rate WhisperX better than the automatic transcript, which WER favors because the annotators kept its word forms.
For the VAD-based systems, WER on the spontaneous and often very short interviewee answers is 1.8 to 2.1 times that on the largely scripted interviewer speech.
The decoding strategy matters more than the model.
Whisper’s default long-form decoding conditions each window on previously decoded text, which carries repetition loops across the silences ( Koenecke et al., 2024 ) : Whisper large-v3 reaches 44.5% WER on the full recordings (24.5 inserted passages per hour), compared with 8.0% for the same model on VAD segments, and large-v3-turbo 30.1%.
Without conditioning, large-v3-turbo reaches 12.8%, and CrisperWhisper 2 improves from 22.2% to 12.8% on VAD segments.
In verbatim mode, CrisperWhisper 2 is the only system that transcribes most filled pauses (64–78% recall vs. at most 30%); its intended mode misses more short answers (13.8% WER).
Errors concentrate where survey research is most sensitive.
Short answers are lost: every system misses 13–23% of single-word reference lines (CrisperWhisper 2 on VAD segments up to 30%), mostly scale points or ja / nein , against at most 1% of lines with ten or more words for the VAD-based systems, and number-word recall ranges from 62% to 87%.
On short segments, several models also switch language or script, and study-specific vocabulary is often garbled.
Since the reference was post-edited from CrisperWhisper output, it favors that transcript: 418 reference tokens (0.73%) are reproduced only by it while most other systems agree on an alternative, so we do not rank it against WhisperX (0.6 points WER apart).
The annotators also differ in thoroughness (Appendix B ) and as each recording was corrected by a single annotator, inter-transcriber agreement cannot be reported.
blocks.zh:
CER和SemDist基本上复制了这个排行榜,但WhisperX的评分比自动抄本要好,WER之所以喜欢,是因为注释者保留了其单词形式.
对于基于VAD的系统,自发且往往非常短的受访者回答的WER是大部分被脚本化的受访者演讲的1.8到2.1倍.
解码策略比模型更重要.
Whisper默认的长式解码条件 每一个窗口在先前已解码的文本上, 都包含着重复循环 横跨沉默(Koenecke等, 2024) : Whisper Big-v3在全程录音中达到44.5%的WER(每小时24.5个插入通道),而VAD片段的同型则达到8.0%,而大V3-涡轮30.1%.
没有空调,大V3涡轮达到12.8%,而CrisperWhisper 2则在VAD部分从22.2%提高到12.8%.
在逐字记录模式中,CrisperWhisper 2是唯一一个将最多填充的暂停(64–78%召回最多为30%)转录的系统;其预定模式错过了更短的答案(13.8% WER).
错误集中在调查研究最敏感的地方。
简短的答案丢失了:每个系统都错过了13–23%的单词参考行(CrisperWhisper 2 on VAD 片段高达30%),大多是比例点或ja / nein,而VAD系统最多只有1%的线有10个或更多个单词,数字词召回率从62%到87%不等.
在短片段上,有几种模型也切换了语言或脚本,而研究上特有的词汇经常被被被花束.
由于该参考文献后从CrisperWhisper输出中编辑出,因此倾向于记录:418个参考符号(0.73%)仅由它复制,而其他大多数系统则商定一个替代品,因此我们不将其排出与WhisperX(0.6分WER相隔)相对.
注释者在透彻性上也有所不同(附录B),由于每次记录都由单个注释者更正,故无法报告互译协议.

blocks.en: 5.2 Negation Annotation and Detection
blocks.zh: 5.2 说明和检测

blocks.en:
The third part of InterView-C annotates negation, a fine-grained linguistic phenomenon on which survey answers often hinge.
Negation resources for conversational language are scarce and negation detection shows substantial cross-corpus variation ( Hammerla et al., 2025b ) , so we annotate negation in the transcribed dialogue, train models on these annotations and compare them with existing models.
As a second downstream use case, we investigate whether InterView-C supports the analysis of a fine-grained linguistic phenomenon, using negation as a case study.
We train negation models on our annotations and assess how released models trained on existing negation corpora perform in this new annotation and data setting.
Given the limited availability of negation resources for conversational language and the poor cross-domain generalization observed in previous work ( Hammerla et al., 2025b ) , our corpus provides an opportunity to study negation in transcribed dialogue.
Following Morante and Blanco (2012) and Jiménez-Zafra et al. (2020) , the task consists of two parts: cue detection identifies words that express negation (e.g., nicht , kein , nie ), while scope detection identifies, for a given cue, the words that fall within its semantic scope.

blocks.en:
We sampled 1,422 sentences from all 27 interviews (52–53 per interview) without conditioning the sampling procedure on negation cues or labels.
The sample is stratified by speaker role and conversational position and contains at most one sentence from each cluster of exact or near-duplicate sentences, reducing the influence of repeated scripted questions.
Splits are defined over complete interviews (21/3/3 for train/validation/test), so evaluation measures generalisation to unseen conversations and interviewees (Appendix C.1.1 ).
Three annotators marked negation cues and linked each cue to its scope, with every sentence independently annotated by two annotators (Appendix C.1.2 ).
Cue agreement is high (Krippendorff’s α = 0.87 \alpha=0.87 ), while scope agreement on instances with identical cues is somewhat lower ( α = 0.81 \alpha=0.81 ), with disagreements primarily concerning scope extent (Appendix C.1.3 ).

我们从所有27次访谈中抽取了1 422个句子(每次访谈52-53个句子),而不以否定提示或标签作为取样程序的条件。
样本按演讲者角色和对话位置进行分级,并最多包含从每组准确或相近重复的句子中取出一句话,减少重复脚本问题的影响.
在完整访谈(列车/验证/测试为21/3/3)中定义了拆分,因此,评价衡量对隐形谈话和被访谈者的概括(附录C.1.1.)。
3个注释员标出否定提示,并将每个提示同其范围联系起来,每个句子由两个注释员独立注释(附录C.1.2.)。
Cue协议很高(Krippendorff的α = 0.87\alpha = 0.87),而关于相同提示的情况的范围协议略低(α = 0.81\alpha = 0.81),主要分歧在于范围(附录C.1.3))。

blocks.en:
We consolidate the two annotations automatically: cue annotations are unioned to favor recall, agreed scopes are retained and disputed scope tokens are resolved with a Dawid–Skene model ( Dawid and Skene, 1979 ) estimated on the training split only; stricter cue annotations and union- and intersection-based scope alternatives are released as well (Appendix C.1.4 ).
The reference contains 342 negation instances in 281 sentences (19.8%; Table 3 ).
The cues are dominated by nicht (54%), followed by nie , response particles ( nein , nee ) and forms of kein ; 58 cue types occur in total.

blocks.en:
We use the syntax-aware D-Neg model of Hammerla et al. (2025a) , based on EuroBERT-210m ( Boizard et al., 2025 ) .
It augments transformer representations with part-of-speech and dependency-relation embeddings and applies a graph attention layer over dependency trees predicted with spaCy ’s de_core_news_sm model ( Montani et al., 2023 ) .
For scope detection, cue words are replaced by [CUE] .
We train D-Neg on our training split for 10 epochs using the original hyperparameters (learning rate 2 ⋅ 10 − 5 2\cdot 10^{-5} , batch size 16, weight decay 0.01), select the best validation-F1 checkpoint, and repeat training with three seeds (42–44).
For comparison, we evaluate all released German GAT variants of D-Neg , trained on German versions of ConanDoyle-neg ( Morante and Daelemans, 2012 ) , SFU Review ( Konstantinova et al., 2012 ) , BioScope ( Vincze et al., 2008 ) , SOCC ( Kolhatkar et al., 2019 ) , and DT-Neg ( Banjade and Rus, 2016 ) , without further fine-tuning.
Because the source corpora also differ in annotation conventions and were translated into German, while our model is trained using the same annotation and consolidation procedure as the test reference, this comparison does not isolate spoken–written domain transfer; it reflects these factors jointly.
All models are evaluated on the same held-out test split; scope detection uses gold cues. We report word-level precision, recall, and F1 for the positive class, plus exact-match accuracy for complete cue and scope predictions.
For our trained model, we report mean and standard deviation across seeds.

blocks.en:
Our in-domain D-Neg model outperforms all released GAT variants on both tasks (Table 4 ), reaching 0.88 F1 for cue detection and 0.66 for scope detection, compared with 0.82 and 0.61 for the strongest transferred models.
Transfer performance varies strongly across source corpora: cue models trained on user-generated text ( SFU Review , SOCC ) perform well, as does the ConanDoyle-neg model, whose annotation guidelines we follow, whereas BioScope reaches at most 0.58 F1. For scope detection, DT-Neg transfers best.
The DT-Neg cue model is an outlier (0.11 F1), frequently misclassifying words such as ich and ja .
Most cue differences lie in the long tail: all models detect nearly all instances of nicht and nie (68% of test cues), whereas our model recovers about eight of the remaining 12 cues, versus two for the strongest transferred model.
The strongest transferred cue models show markedly lower recall than ours (0.71–0.74 vs. 0.89), despite higher precision (0.93 vs. 0.88).
Scope predictions are conservative: precision exceeds recall (0.81 vs. 0.56), predicted scopes are shorter than references (3.6 vs. 5.1 tokens), and 32% are strict subsets versus 14% strict supersets (see Appendix C.3 for detailed results and error analyses).

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We presented InterView-C, a corpus of 27 German survey interviews conducted entirely in virtual reality between two human interlocutors represented by avatars.
It combines VR interaction data with synchronized tracking of both speakers and human reference transcripts, as well as negation cue and scope annotations.
These provide an interface between multimodal interaction and predominantly text-based NLP methods.
Our evaluations show that the points at which such a pipeline can fail are important in practice.
Once decoding is no longer dependent on text decoded before a silence, errors in ASR concentrate on short closed answers, number words, and negation cues – the tokens on which survey responses depend.
Negation models trained on existing corpora show variable transfer to the transcribed interviews and generally underperform in-domain training, although differences in annotation conventions, translation and label construction mean that this gap cannot be attributed to the spoken-interaction domain alone.
Future work will use the nonverbal streams to investigate how gaze, head movement and facial expression relate to responses on sensitive items and spoken negation.
InterView-C thus enables linguistic analyses of spoken interaction while retaining their alignment with multimodal behavior.
By releasing all three parts, we hope to support research at the intersection of survey methodology, multimodal dialogue and spoken language processing.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍了InterView-C, 共27次德国调查访谈,
它将VR互动数据与同步跟踪发言者和人类参考记录以及否定提示和范围说明结合起来。
它们提供了多式联运互动和主要基于文本的NLP方法之间的接口。
我们的评估表明,这种管道可能失败的点在实践中是重要的。
一旦解码不再依赖沉默前的文本解码,ASR中的错误集中在短的闭合答案,数字词和否定提示上 — — 即调查答案所依赖的标志.
接受过现有公司化培训的忽略模型显示向转录访谈的可变转移,并且一般在域内培训表现不佳,尽管在注释惯例,翻译和标签构造上的差异意味着这一差距不能仅仅归因于口头互动领域.
未来工作将利用非言语流来调查视线、头部移动和面部表情如何与敏感物品和口语否定的反应相关。
因此,InterView-C可以对口语互动进行语言分析,同时保持其与多模式行为的一致性。
通过公布所有三个部分,我们希望支持调查方法、多模式对话和口语处理之间的交叉研究。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
The corpus is small and unbalanced: 27 interviewees (19 male, 8 female), three interviewers with 19, 6 and 2 interviews, one questionnaire and German only.
The interviewers were members of the project team and the interviewer’s avatar was not randomized, so interviewer, avatar and interviewee choice are partly confounded.
Additionally, the interviewees were all highly educated and the interviewers had no prior interviewing experience.
Findings on interview behavior should therefore be treated as exploratory.

面试者是项目团队的成员,而面试者的相貌并没有被随机化,因此面试者,相貌者和被采访者的选择部分令人困惑.
此外,受访者都受过高等教育,而受访者没有事先的面谈经验。
因此,关于面谈行为的调查结果应当视为探索性的。

blocks.en: Tracking is logged at a median of 18.4 Hz, which is too coarse for saccade-level eye-movement analysis or brief facial events and the hands were tracked in only about 40% of the frames.

blocks.en:
Because the audio is withheld, third parties cannot evaluate new systems on our reference.
Each recording was post-edited by a single annotator starting from CrisperWhisper output, so the reference favors that system and may retain errors that other systems share.
Additionally, two annotators made noticeably fewer corrections than the others.

由于这些音频被扣留,第三方不能根据我们的情况评估新系统。
每次录音后都由单一的注释员从 CrisperWhisper 输出开始编辑,因此参考文献有利于这个系统,并可能保留其他系统共享的错误.
此外,两名注释员的更正明显少于其他。

blocks.en:
The test split contains only 37 negation instances, so model differences of a few points are not reliable.
The reference is consolidated automatically (cues by union) and it may contains annotation errors that we identify but do not correct.

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en:
All participants gave informed consent for the recording and release of de-identified data for research purposes.
The release withholds the raw audio, replaces directly identifying information in the transcripts with typed placeholders and is shared only on request under a data use agreement that restricts use to non-commercial research and prohibits re-identification.
Logging the tracking at 18.4 Hz further limits identification from gaze, since eye-movement biometrics degrade markedly at 50 Hz and below ( Lohr and Komogortsev, 2022 ) .
Head and hand motion, however, remain identifying even when subsampled to 10 Hz ( Nair et al., 2024 ) , so a residual risk remains (Section 4.4 ).
The residual re-identification risk of the tracking data is discussed in Section 4.4 .

blocks.en: Appendix A Synchronization Details
blocks.zh: 附录 A 同步细节

blocks.en:
Each headset stamps all of its streams with its own local clock.
Because some headsets deviated from wall time, each session’s clock was mapped onto a shared clock with a constant offset estimated as the minimum of the server’s arrival time minus the local time over the session.
Queuing delay is never negative, so the least-delayed packet gives the best estimate.
Using a single constant per session keeps jitter of server arrival times out of the timing.
Sub-second timing comes from the audio sample clock.
The client sends data in flushes, each consisting of an audio chunk and the sensor samples recorded in the same time window.
The client stamps each flush with the local time at the end of the window.
Audio chunks are contiguous between reconnections; therefore, each contiguous run is anchored from the median of the local time minus the cumulative sample time.
This reduces the one-second quantization of the local clock (standard deviation 0.29 s per chunk) to about 0.29 / n 0.29/\sqrt{n} s for a run of n n chunks.
Precision resets only at a reconnect.
Sensor samples are spread over the time window of the audio chunk they were sent with and therefore inherit its precision.
Words are mapped from audio time through the chunks and word durations are taken from the audio sample clock, so tracking frames, words and item windows share one timeline.

blocks.en: Appendix B Transcription Details
blocks.zh: 附录B 细节

blocks.en:
Reference lines carry no reliable timestamps since those inserted by annotators have none.
We therefore locate each line through the segment-level systems, whose output is stored per VAD segment.
Every reference word aligned to a hypothesis word by the WER alignment votes for that word’s segment. This is pooled over Qwen3-ASR, Parakeet, Canary and Voxtral.
Each line takes the segments holding at least a quarter of its votes and this is kept monotone over time.
Lines that no system recognizes are placed in an unclaimed segment between their neighbors.
The text of each group of segments is then aligned to its audio using CTC forced alignment and the German wav2vec 2.0 model, which has been fine-tuned on VoxPopuli.

每个参考词与假说词一致, 这是在Qune3 -ASR、Parakeet、Canary和Voxtral集合。

blocks.en: C.1.1 Sampling Procedure
blocks.zh: C.1.1 取样程序

blocks.en:
Dialogue turns from all 27 interviews were automatically segmented into sentences; short interruptions by the other speaker were conservatively bridged, yielding 232 sampled sentences reconstructed across turns.
Candidate sentences were required to contain at least two words, begin with a capital letter and end in terminal punctuation without a truncating ellipsis.
Candidates with unbalanced brackets, transcription artifacts, incomplete syntactic endings or more than 120 words were also removed.
In total, 2,436 candidates failed these form-based checks, leaving 4,220 eligible sentences.
No negation information (cue lexicon, labels or model predictions) was used at any stage of sampling.
We drew a stratified random sample with seed 42.
Each interview contributed 52 or 53 sentences.
Within each interview, the quota was allocated between interviewer and interviewee in proportion to the number of distinct (non-duplicate) sentences available for each role, with a minimum of ten sentences per role and distributed across five chronological positions in the conversation.
To satisfy the duplicate constraint below, positional quotas were relaxed: all five positions are represented, but not equally (448/195/254/241/284 sentences).
All 30 speakers contribute at least ten sentences.
Because many interview questions are scripted, sentences were grouped into duplicate clusters if they were identical after normalization (NFKC, case folding, punctuation removal) or, for sentences of at least six tokens, near-identical (character similarity ≥ 0.92 \geq 0.92 ).
At most one sentence per cluster was sampled across the entire corpus and therefore across splits.
The 4,220 eligible sentences form 2,121 clusters; 232 contain more than one sentence, with the largest containing 46.
Near-duplicate matching is not applied to sentences shorter than six tokens, since a single character can distinguish different answers ( Gar nicht. vs. Gar nichts. ); 36 near-identical short pairs therefore remain in the sample, nine of them spanning two splits.
Under these constraints, the corpus supports a sample of 1,422 sentences (mean length 9.0 tokens, median 6).
Because duplicate control removes most repeated scripted questions, interviewers contribute 630 sentences (44.3%) despite producing 69.1% of the eligible sentences; interviewees contribute 792 (55.7%).
The three interviewers contribute 83, 210 and 337 sentences; exact balance was infeasible under the joint constraints.
Splits were defined over complete interviews: 21 interviews for training (1,106 sentences), 3 for validation (158) and 3 for testing (158).
Each held-out split contains one interview by each of the three interviewers.
The task therefore evaluates generalization to unseen conversations and interviewees, but not to unseen interviewers.

blocks.en: C.1.2 Annotation Guidelines
blocks.zh: C.1.2 说明准则

blocks.en:
Three annotators labeled the sampled sentences in a web interface.
Sentences were presented one at a time, without surrounding dialogue context, in a seeded random order.
Annotators marked every expression functioning as a negation cue, with cues optionally spanning multiple tokens and linked each cue to the tokens in its semantic scope.
Scopes associated with different cues were allowed to overlap.
Each sentence was assigned to one of the three annotator pairs in rotation, so every sentence received two independent annotations, with each pair assigned exactly one third of the sample (474 sentences).

注释者将每个表达式标记为否定提示,提示可以选择跨越多个符号,并将每个提示同其语义范围中的符号联系起来。

blocks.en: C.1.3 Inter-Annotator Agreement
blocks.zh: C.1.3 通知人 协议

blocks.en:
Agreement was measured at the token level.
Because no sentence was annotated by all three annotators, we report pairwise Cohen’s κ \kappa together with Krippendorff’s nominal α \alpha , which accommodates missing ratings.
Cue agreement is high ( α = 0.87 \alpha=0.87 ).
Annotators agree on whether a sentence contains negation at all in 96.6% of the 1,398 doubly annotated sentences (pooled pairwise κ = 0.88 \kappa=0.88 ) and their cue annotations are identical for 93.8–96.3% of shared sentences.
Scope agreement is computed only for negation instances whose cue tokens match exactly between the two annotators (254 instances).
Token-level agreement is α = 0.81 \alpha=0.81 and complete scopes are identical in 59.3–75.3% of these instances.
When scopes differ, they differ by three to five tokens on average and the disagreements are largely systematic: A3 marks wider scopes than A1 (94 vs. 15 tokens labeled as scope by only one of the two).

blocks.en: C.1.4 Consolidation
blocks.zh: C.1.4 合并

blocks.en: We derive a single reference annotation automatically rather than through manual adjudication.
blocks.zh: 我们自动得出一个单一的参考说明,而不是通过人工裁定。

blocks.en:
Cue tokens are unioned across annotators, favoring recall; this adds 80 cue tokens marked by only one of the two annotators.
Negation instances are aligned across annotators through their cue tokens.
Proposals whose cue tokens overlap without being identical are merged into one instance (12 cases, typically a multi-word cue that one annotator marked only partially).
In one sentence, the alignment is ambiguous; its separate proposals are retained, flagged and excluded from model fitting.

blocks.en:
The reference contains 342 negation instances.
For 178, both annotators assign the same scope, which is retained.
For 76, only one annotator provides the aligned cue and that annotator’s scope is copied.
The remaining 88 instances contain 312 disputed tokens; tokens on which both annotators agree retain their label.
We resolve the disputed tokens with a binary Dawid–Skene model ( Dawid and Skene, 1979 ) , which estimates a sensitivity and specificity for each annotator and combines the observed labels into the posterior probability that a token belongs to the scope.
Tokens with a posterior of at least 0.5 are assigned to the scope; 136 of the 312 disputed tokens have a posterior between 0.4 and 0.6.
Parameters are estimated with MAP-EM on all tokens (agreed and disputed) of training-split instances annotated by both annotators with an unambiguous alignment (2,646 tokens) and then applied unchanged to all splits, so validation and test annotations do not influence them.
We use weak Beta \mathrm{Beta} priors with mode 0.9 on sensitivity and specificity.
The estimated sensitivities are 0.91, 0.92 and 0.98 and the specificities 0.99, 0.98 and 0.94 for A1–A3.

blocks.en: C.2 Training Details
blocks.zh: C.2 培训细节

blocks.en:
Our models follow the D-Neg training setup, with four modifications.
First, labels are assigned only to the first subword of each word, ensuring that training and evaluation are performed at the word level.
Second, because the EuroBERT tokenizer removes the leading space from pre-segmented words, we restore it before tokenization so that subword segmentation matches that obtained from running text.
Third, before dependency parsing, we remove punctuation attached to words, preserving a one-to-one correspondence between input words and parser tokens.
Fourth, we train for 10 epochs and select the checkpoint with the highest validation F1 rather than the lowest validation loss.
Training sentences exceeding the maximum sequence length are excluded for the GAT model; no validation or test sentence exceeds this limit.
The released D-Neg models are evaluated using their original inference code without modification.

blocks.en:
Table 7 reports precision, recall, F1 and exact match for all GAT models.
